name: Upstox Read-Only FnO Universe Foundation v1
lawful_access_basis: Private local research through the operator-owned Upstox account; no display, redistribution, alerts, orders, or trading. The public NSE instrument master does not require the Analytics Token.
fields: current NSE FnO stock-underlying identifiers and symbols
current NSE stock-option contract identifier, call or put, strike, expiry, lot size, tick size and lifecycle evidence
provider retrieval timestamp, local UTC receipt timestamp and raw content hash
future approved underlying daily, 15-minute and 5-minute OHLCV and current quote observations
latency: Current instrument-master snapshot now; historical and ongoing underlying observations remain blocked until their exact dates and cadence are approved.
collection_method: GET-only Upstox NSE instrument master for the approved baseline. Historical-candle and full-quote routes are implemented but remain inactive in this phase.
retention_policy: Private local storage; raw payloads may be retained for seven days under the existing policy, while hashes, manifests, coverage, quality and deletion records remain permanent.
